papers.title: Introduction to and Recent Developments in Bayesian Causal Inference: Propensity Scores, Treatment Effect Heterogeneity, and Sensitivity Analysis

Flagship 55/60 Can randomized or justified quasi-experimental intervention isolate the manufacturing effect from cell-lot, material and culture confounding? CAUSAL VERIFICATION AND COUNTERFACTUAL CONTROL IN NANOROBOT-ASSISTED REGENERATIVE MANUFACTURING AT THE LIMIT This 777-page Research Design Working Edition in the STARLI Nano Regenerative Biomanufacturing series investigates intervention-defined causal treatment contrast rather than observational association. Its scientific coupling is causal inference x microscale interventions x biological functional validation. The evidence perimeter is prospective and nonclinical, using closed in-vitro systems, organ-on-chip platforms or authorized ex-vivo material; neither clinical efficacy nor autonomous human intervention is claimed. The falsifiable question is: Can randomized or justified quasi-experimental intervention isolate the manufacturing effect from cell-lot, material and culture confounding? The proposed minimum demonstration is: Randomize tool action within balanced chip batches, retain sham and medium-only controls, and repeat on a second platform. Strong comparators include correlational predictor, nonrandomized matched cohort and randomized sham manipulation. The central competing explanation is shared medium, selection, interference or time-dependent confounding. The noncompensatory stop rule is: negative controls exhibit the claimed effect or modest unmeasured confounding reverses it. Every eligible, stopped, refused and unsuccessful experiment belongs to the full denominator. Thirty conditional mathematical plates specify different analytic roles, measurements, units and blind failure tests. Eighty-two chapters contain 410 individual research investigations. Two hundred Research Gates organize twenty causal challenge families across ten primary physical observables, each with an independently read companion, concealed intervention, matched comparator, explicit rival and refusal gate. Thirty-three Phoenix Answer Embryos propose future experimental and evidence instruments. All are experimental plans rather than executed observations. The source Atlas and methodology ancestors provide reference architecture but do not establish the new integrated candidate. Source-supplied ancestry includes 10.5281/zenodo.23046134 and 10.5281/zenodo.23486020; source-associated external DOI candidates must be bibliographically checked before citation. Research Gate lexical differentiation is not proof of scientific originality. The PDF is English-only and a separate QA record states outstanding independent physics, biology and DOI verification.
